findings.name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search Parameter
findings.description: Search query inputs are reflected directly into the HTML response without sanitization, allowing arbitrary script execution in the victim's browser context.
findings.solution: Sanitize and encode all user-supplied inputs before rendering in HTML. Implement a strict Content-Security-Policy.

findings.name: SQL Injection in User Authentication Endpoint
findings.description: The login endpoint constructs database queries using unescaped user parameters. Sending a crafted username bypasses authentication and permits data extraction.
findings.solution: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings.

findings.name: Missing HttpOnly & Secure Flags on Session Cookies
findings.description: Session cookies are issued without the HttpOnly and Secure flags, making them accessible via JavaScript (enabling XSS-based theft) and transmittable over plaintext connections.

poc.payload: Set-Cookie: session_id=abc123; Path=/ (observed — no HttpOnly, no Secure, no SameSite)

findings.solution: Set HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict on all authentication cookies.
